verdicts.summary: The '.'-is-ignored probe can wrongly fire at the repository root when the root .gitignore uses the common allowlist idiom `*` followed by `!` negations. The capture then switches to `add -u`, so new non-ignored files are left out of checkpoints. A later restore runs `git clean -fd`, which deletes those files.
verdicts.scenario:
1) The repo root's .gitignore is `*
!.gitignore
!*/
!src/**` (a dotfiles-style allowlist), and the project cwd is the repo root. 2) GitVcsDriver.ts:969 runs `check-ignore --no-index` on `.`. At the root, the pathspec match is the empty string. Going by git's dir.c (which I did not open in this session and could not run): `*` is an ENDSWITH/NODIR pattern, so match_basename matches the empty basename. `!*/` is skipped because resolve_dtype("") gets no dir type from lstat. So git reports `.` as ignored, filterIgnoredPaths returns [], and workspaceIgnored=true. 3) Tracked files exist (.gitignore), so line 1018 does not fire, and line 1038 stages with `add -u`. 4) In turn 1 the agent creates src/new.ts, which the negation allows and git does not ignore. It is left out of the turn-1 checkpoint tree, so the turn shows no file or diff for it. 5) Later the user restores to the turn-1 checkpoint. restoreCheckpoint runs `git clean -fd -- .` (GitVcsDriver.ts:1211), which deletes src/new.ts because it is untracked, not ignored, and absent from the checkpoint. Before this commit, `add -A` captured the file and the restore kept it. No test covers a root-level capture under a `*` ignore rule: the new test at GitVcsDriver.test.ts:313 only captures in subdirectories, and the harness only uses `*.log`.
verdicts.consequence: With an allowlist .gitignore at the root, checkpoints silently leave out new non-ignored files. Turn diffs miss them, and restoring a checkpoint deletes files the agent or user created in that turn.
verdicts.missing: Running git to confirm that `git check-ignore --no-index .` at the repo root reports `.` under a `*` pattern. My reasoning comes from git's dir.c match_basename/ENDSWITH logic, which is not in the checkout.
